decision_summary: Implement v0.6.32 by extending calibration-report with executable Calibration Cohort records.
rationale: Visionary: expose who and what an aggregate represents. Builder: derive membership and segment arithmetic from existing pairs with structured rules. Guardian: structure cannot prove representativeness or independence; unresolved dependence, drift, missingness, or high-risk segment failure must route to governance.
recommendation: Add cohort schema, example, deterministic verifier logic, fixtures, plain-language docs, roadmap and release evidence.
target_audience: QIF users, AI agents, reviewers, and governance owners
expected_user_reaction: Users can see exactly what is inside and outside an aggregate calibration claim.
